title: Business Analyst
summary: You’ll work in teams of typically 3 – 5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of the client engagement. This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You’ll also have the opportunity to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.

You’ll gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm. Business analysts receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. This support includes a partner from your local office or practice assigned to you to help guide your career as well as several weeks of formal training in your first two years as a business analyst. Additionally, you’ll receive guidance and support from your local office in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.

We view the business analyst position as the start of a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible career with McKinsey. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a BA on multiple client engagements and work with a number of colleagues and clients in a range of industry and functional areas. We encourage you to explore different content areas or geographies through a year-long rotation with one of our practices (e.g., corporate finance, social sector, healthcare, operations) or global offices.

title: Associate (m/w/d)
location: Berlin, Cologne, Dusseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich, Stuttgart, Vienna
summary: Als Associate wirst du Teil eines Beratungsteams und übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Projektstrang, um zentrale Herausforderungen unserer Klienten zu lösen.

Dabei handelt es sich um einige der einflussreichsten Organisationen weltweit, von Fortune-500- und DAX-Unternehmen bis hin zu innovativen Start-ups. Bei uns wirst du gefordert – und gefördert. Du erarbeitest Lösungen für aktuelle und drängende Problemstellungen und treibst langfristige Veränderung an. Wir vertrauen auf dein Urteilsvermögen und deine Zuverlässigkeit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Empfehlungen wirksam und nachhaltig sind.

Du bist vor Ort beim Klienten und hilfst dabei, die wesentlichen Herausforderungen hinter einer Strategie zu ergründen und realisierbare Maßnahmen zu entwickeln. Gemeinsam mit unseren Klienten und deinen McKinsey-Kolleg:innen kombinierst du Research, Datenanalyse, Interviews und Brainstorming, um neue Erkenntnisse und innovative Lösungen zu erarbeiten. Mit deinem Engagement für unsere Werte gewinnst du das Vertrauen unserer Klienten und erzielst im Team Ergebnisse, die echte Veränderung bewirken.

Wir fördern unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn sie sind entscheidend, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity.  We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You will work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.
You will help clients to change industries, transform business models, and create competitive advantages. You will advise some of the largest, most innovative companies in a variety of industries, including oil and gas, metals and mining, telecommunications, retail, banking and finance.
You will have the opportunity to assist, learn from, challenge, and be challenged by leaders. We will constantly invest in your personal development through daily coaching and mentoring coupled with comprehensive training programs that begin soon after you join and continue throughout your McKinsey career.
As part of your daily work you will gather and analyze information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You will present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.
You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. You will also receive close guidance and support from your local office or practice in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.
Bachelor’s degree and/or postgraduate degree (Master’s, MBA, PhD) in Engineering (Chemical, Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics)
Proven experience in the energy sector and business management
Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex issues
Strong logical reasoning and creative thinking abilities
Quantitative aptitude
Initiative and eagerness to explore new opportunities, create value for others, and take personal risks
Native level language skills in Spanish with fluent English skills (fluent in writing and speaking)

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Product Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
A BCG Product Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
YOU'RE GOOD AT
Product Management
· Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
· Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
· Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
· Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
· Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
· Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
· Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones
Product Delivery
· As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
· Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
· Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
· Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
· Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
· Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap
AI-Native ways of working
· Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
· Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
· Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
· Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
· Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
· Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
· Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration
· 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
· Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
· Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
· A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
· Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
· Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
· Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
· Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
· Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1
